title: REQ · Poll closes expired OPEN Rounds through the snapshot-freezing Closer
summary: OPEN Rounds past EndsAt are closed via Closer.Close and reported as ClosedNow and Closed
description: Context: round.Service.Close writes the immutable snapshot and moves the Round to CLOSED. Desired behavior: for every OPEN Round with !clock.Now().Before(EndsAt), Poll calls Closer.Close(ctx, worldID, roundID); on success the ID is added to Result.ClosedNow and Result.Closed. Expected result: expired Rounds are frozen without the poller touching contribution files. Why: contributions must freeze at the Round end.
acceptance_criteria: Given an OPEN Round with EndsAt equal to or before the clock time, when Poll runs, then Close is called once with that world and round ID.
Given an OPEN Round with EndsAt after the clock time, when Poll runs, then Close is not called.
Given a successful close, then the ID appears in Result.ClosedNow and Result.Closed.

in_scope: Closer interface and expiry check in Poll
out_of_scope: Snapshot writing, which stays in backend/internal/round

technical_constraints: Time comes only from the injected Clock
